vb_textbox.text: You will notice that each pair of gnomes appear in different colours. The colours do not make any difference, it's the shade that matters. Each time a pair of gnomes appear there is one wearing darker shades of clothing and one light. I tried each randomly at first until I became aware that it was one or the other that was collecting the most mushrooms. Once I had realised which shade was collecting the most, I went with that one each time until the number dropped, then I changed to the other shade for a while. Sometimes they are both the same, but on the the whole, one is better than the other. I hope this helps.
